messages:
maya-cs: Hey team, Acadia Health says their March invoice jumped and flipped their plan tier. Dashboard shows ~1.21M tokens for Feb, invoice shows 1.79M and bumped them to Pro. Customer upset re: unexpected charge, asking for explanation and credit. invoice id INV-2025-03-01. Can we triage? :eyes:
liam-billing: Thanks Maya. Can you paste the dashboard totals + the billed line items (CSV or screenshot)? Also need account_id and the invoice breakdown IDs.
maya-cs: Account: acct_0a1b2c. Dashboard export pasted below:
```
dashboard_total_tokens: 1210345
dashboard_period: 2025-02-01 to 2025-02-28
dashboard_plan: Starter (tier cap 1.5M)
```
Invoice lines (from billing UI):
```
line_1: base plan Starter - $50
line_2: billed_tokens: 1789012 - $139.20
invoice_total: $189.20
```
They attached the CSV; billing UI shows tokens that cause tier flip.
raj-eng: Ok I'll inspect metering logs and ingestion pipeline. Two quick hypotheses: 1) timezone/cutoff mismatch around UTC boundary caused some events from 2025-03-01 to be included in Feb invoice, or 2) duplicate counting due to retries/hook double-ingest. Can you give a few request_ids or sample timestamps?
maya-cs: Pushing a subset of request IDs from customer's support app: req_4f7a1, req_4f7a2, req_4f7b9. Most from 2025-03-01T00:01:10Z to 2025-03-01T00:03:05Z. Customer says their app rotated timezone to PST at EOM; they suspected edge-case.
raj-eng: Running quick aggregation against meter_events for acct_0a1b2c:
```
-- run by raj
select date_trunc('minute', ts) as minute, sum(tokens) as tokens
from meter_events
where account_id = 'acct_0a1b2c'
and ts >= '2025-02-28T23:55:00Z' and ts < '2025-03-01T00:10:00Z'
group by 1
order by 1;
```
I see a spike: 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z -> 450k tokens, and another at 00:01 -> 120k. Dashboard export (which client used) was in PST and cut at Feb 28 23:59 PST, which is Mar 1 07:59 UTC. So cutoff mismatch looks suspicious.
elena-data: FWIW, our metering-service v2.3.1 had a change to how we compute window edges: we switched to using account local tz on export in the UI but billing pipeline expects UTC cutoffs. There was a patch deployed 2025-02-27 that introduced a mismatch for UI exports vs invoice ingestion. That can cause the dashboard CSV to under-report compared to invoice, not double-count, but window shifts. Also saw a rare retry de-dup bug for uploads older than 30s that we are patching.
liam-billing: So combination: customer saw a dashboard export that used PST-local cutoff (rolled earlier) and invoice pipeline used UTC leading to more events included in Feb invoice. That explains tokens difference magnitude? 1.21M -> 1.79M seems consistent with those 00:00-08:00 UTC events.
raj-eng: Yes. Also found ~3k events where retry requests were logged twice due to missing idempotency key in an internal SDK. Those add O(50k) tokens, not the whole gap.
liam-billing: Proposed remediation: 1) Roll back UI export behavior to use billing UTC cutoffs (hotfix). 2) Patch SDK idempotency bug and retro-process duplicate meter_events for affected accounts. 3) Issue pro-rated credit for Acadia for the overcharged amount and re-issue corrected invoice INV-2025-03-01-R1.
maya-cs: Customer wants a credit + corrected invoice, please keep them in the loop. I'll open ticket TKT-5523 and set expected timeline.
elena-data: I'll run a one-off correction job to compute corrected tokens for acct_0a1b2c for Feb window using billing UTC logic and produce a delta report. ETA 6 hours.
raj-eng: I'll ship the rollback to the UI export cutoff now and the idempotency patch to staging. If tests pass, I can deploy to prod in next deploy window (30m).
liam-billing: Once correction report is in, I'll calculate the dollar credit, prepare a credit memo and send to Acadia with a brief explanation and internal root cause.
maya-cs: Thanks all. I'll reply to Acadia: apology + credit + ticket TKT-5523 + timeline 24h for corrected invoice. :pray:
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-2025-03-01 flagged for manual review by billing team (trigger: discrepancy > 25%).
raj-eng: Action items summary: - raj: rollback UI export cutoff (in 30m) + idempotency patch (deploy after tests) - elena: correction job + delta report (6h) - liam: prepare credit memo + corrected invoice - maya: customer comms + TKT-5523.
liam-billing: Assigning owners in Jira: BILL-870 (credit + invoice), METER-992 (dedupe job), UI-431 (export rollback).
maya-cs: Closing loop with customer in thread after credit issued. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
